slice: Surname list: full INE national census (surnames >=20 in Spain, present in Mallorca); counts: INE municipality reconstruction
isonymy_source: INE surname census (mapaWidget&vista=muni; count = rate‰ × INE padrón 2025 population)

biparental.note: Biparental isonymy on the shared Mallorca-endemic surname set (LQ>=1.3, >=20 bearers, non-foreign; defined on the first-surname national frequencies). first=paternal line (INE tipo=1), second=maternal-grandfather line (tipo=2), combined=both surname tokens pooled and normalised by 2x population. Marginals only; no person-level pairing needed. Second-surname endemism reuses the first-surname national denominator (indicative); the municipal tipo=2 rates are genuine INE data.
